mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) above 2% year-over-year signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4% signals a tightening labor market, leading to wage inflation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4%.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) above 1.5 million units signals strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST > 1.5 million.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) below 100 signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) above 200,000 signals strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS > 200,000.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) above 1% month-over-month signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when RSAFS MoM > 1%.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) combined with an increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2% signals conflicting monetary signals, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS decreases and CPIAUCSL YoY > 2%.
